NewsArticle.Title: Classes
NewsArticle.Content: Class instructor names on the [schedule](http://www.darkages.com/2000/community/news/class.html) will be linked to search for the instructor's name in the Temuair Library. Class description will be linked as well. Class instructors, please send confirmation of your classes, including date, time, and description of the class. Confirmed class schedules will be updated. Unconfirmed classes will be removed from the schedule. Teaching classes earns nobility, including unique noble garments. Rumor has it that there may be new unique noble garments in a Deoch or two. Exceptional classes or series of classes may qualify for the [Events contest.](http://www.darkages.com/2000/news/000830.html) Uistean Mileth College Librarian
